Solar, UV and peak rain rate records compare daily peaks: their lowest value is the lowest daily peak, not a nighttime minimum. Direction is circular, so use the wind rose instead of numeric min/max. Averages of daily means are unweighted; gaps remain missing. Today is a partial day.

Connect your station & deploy on GitHub ↗

Upload the contents of the supplied ZIP to a GitHub repository with a main branch. In Settings → Pages, choose GitHub Actions.

  1. Add your Weather Underground / The Weather Company API key as the Actions secret WU_API_KEY. Use an API key with access to this station's historical observations; the station upload password is a different credential.
  2. Set the repository variable WU_INSTALLATION_DATE to the actual installation date (YYYY-MM-DD) to backfill from that date. Without it, the default is the last 30 days.
  3. Open Actions → Update weather & deploy Pages → Run workflow. Historical days load in batches; the scheduled workflow refreshes approximately every 30 minutes.

The key stays in GitHub Actions. The public site reads the generated observation files. Missing sensors stay blank; no data is invented. See README.md in the download for the full guide.
